PR: Disable wsl_v5 linter [closed]
### Description of your changes

I think this is the linter that's been adding whitespace everywhere throughout the codebase. I thought it was gofumpt since it's a form of formatting and I couldn't figure out which of golangci-lint's formatters were doing this.

I think it's actually a linter that is auto "fixing" the lack of whitespace (aka formatting)...

Either way I don't think we really care about the opinions of this somewhat obscure linter, and we'd already tried to disable it. At this point I merged a PR

that applied its whitespace opinions to the existing codebase but I don't really want local formatters to fight it going forward.
